messages:
pagerbridge-bot: ALERT: Failed to deliver page to on-call (rotation: infra-sre). HTTP 502 from /v1/pagerbridge/forward :rotating_light:

ryan: saw this in monitoring, getting multiple 502s for the pagerbridge upstream. paging appears to be stuck in fallback loop.

dana: confirmed, cc @priya — our incident channel didn't get the page. Ops dashboard shows requests getting retried and then dropped.

priya: looking now. 502 started ~5m ago, spike in error rate from the bridge host pool behind lb-us-west-2-1.

jamal: are we sure it's PagerBridge and not PagerDuty webhook flapping? both integrations touched last week.

ryan: good q. logs show pagerbridge returned 502 to our forwarder. PD webhooks are fine upstream, forwarder retries but then hits rate limiter on our side? unclear.

priya: pulling container logs. running:```
kubectl logs -n infra svc/pagerbridge-forwarder-0 -c forwarder --since=10m
```

priya: found repeated stack traces: "Error: upstream response 502 Bad Gateway" and a bunch of backoff retries.

oncall-bot: SYSTEM: On-call notification failed for infra-sre (dana) — attempted via pagerbridge, no ack.

ryan: temp mitigation — can someone flip the routing to use pd-direct (bypass pagerbridge) for infra-sre? that should get pages through while we fix bridge.

dana: I can accept direct pages for now. How do we flip?

jamal: There's a fallback rule in ops-config:```
- name: pager_fallback
  if: pagerbridge_unreachable
  route: pd-direct
```
But seems the detector didn't fire because forwarder returned 502 instead of timing out.

priya: I can patch the detector to treat 5xx as unreachable. Quick patch:```
if response.status >= 500:
  mark_unreachable()
```
Deploying now to canary.

ryan: :thumbsup: deploy the patch and then manually trigger fallback for infra-sre if it doesn't auto-flip in 30s.

priya: canary deployed to forwarder-1. watching logs.

(priya posts log excerpt)
```
2026-03-15T15:12:08Z forwarder INFO attempt 12 -> pd-direct
2026-03-15T15:12:08Z forwarder WARN switching route to pd-direct (detected 5xx)
```

priya: canary showed correct switch. I'm promoting to all replicas.

oncall-bot: NOTICE: routing changed for infra-sre -> pd-direct. Pages will go via PD direct for now.

dana: got the page. thanks.

ryan: good. next: root cause — why did pagerbridge return 502s under normal load?

priya: preliminary: one of the backend auth services (pb-auth) had a memory leak; it hit OOM and restarted; forwarder receives 502 when auth fails. pb-auth restarted 3 times in 10 minutes.

jamal: pb-auth restarts line up with spike. any recent deploys?

priya: yes, a small auth change went out yesterday in canary and promoted this morning. rolling back pb-auth to previous revision now.

ryan: rollback started. also add an alert on pb-auth OOM rate and a synthetic check that posts a test page through pagerbridge every 1m.

priya: rollback finished. pb-auth stable, no more 502s in the last 3m.

oncall-bot: INFO: page delivery resumed via pagerbridge. Routing will revert to default after 10m if no errors.

dana: double-checking customer impact: any missed customer pages? I scanned incident history — looks like only internal infra-sre was affected. No external customer alerts.

ryan: add a post-incident todo: make 5xx count as signal for routing fallback, add end-to-end test for pages, and add PD escalation in case fallback fails.

jamal: also add runbook step: if fallback doesn't trigger, manually flip route and notify SRE rotation.

priya: creating a follow-up ticket and will include logs + stack traces + rollout that introduced leak.

ryan: thanks everyone. main takeaways: pagers didn't reach on-call until fallback was forced; detector logic assumed unreachable only on timeout, not 5xx. small change fixed it. postmortem/incident doc pls. :memo:
